concepts.title: Will Lift For Pizza Funny Gym T-Shirt
concepts.image_prompt: Flat vector illustration style, bold simple shapes. A cartoon barbell on one side and a happy slice of pizza on the other, connected by an arrow or thought bubble. Use 3-4 flat colors like red, yellow, grey, black. White or transparent background. No photorealism. Print-ready for apparel.
